assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease.
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded as I25.10.
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation.
Unspecified atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.91.
Mobile cardiac telemetry corresponds to CPT 93229.
The monitoring is intended to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes.
These events may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The service addresses the clinical need for diagnosis code R55.
Diagnosis code R55 is associated with the patient's cardiac history.
